title: Filter, search & order
summary: Turn query parameters like ?status=done&search=deploy&ordering=-due_date into a safe queryset.
hints: filter gives back a new queryset, so always store it: queryset = queryset.filter(...). You can do this as many times as you like.
params.get('status') gives None when the parameter is missing and '' when it's empty. Both are false, so if params.get('status'): skips them.
date.fromisoformat('2025-03-01') raises ValueError on bad input, which is exactly what test 7 wants, so don't catch it. Then filter with due_date__lte= that date.
Ordering: if ordering in ALLOWED_ORDERING: sort by it, else: sort by 'id'. Return the result of order_by.

quiz.question: Why whitelist the values allowed in ?ordering=?
options: So clients can't sort by (and so probe) private or unindexed fields
quiz.explanation: Sorting by an arbitrary field can leak information (e.g. ?ordering=owner__password) or trigger slow queries. Only allow what you support.

quiz.question: When does Task.objects.filter(status='done') hit the database?
quiz.explanation: Querysets are lazy, which is what makes chaining filters cheap.
